messages:
maria: Quick thread — following the Acme acquisition we inherited several projects and ~120 KMS keys and a bunch of admin roles. Need to propose a pragmatic access review + cleanup plan. Thinking: 1) snapshot current owners, 2) run least-privilege simulation, 3) schedule staged revocations with fallback. Anyone have strong objections or gotchas?

josh: +1. Do we have complete cross-account trust mappings? last time those made role pruning messy.

maria: Not fully. Kevin is working on mapping trusts. We do have CloudTrail and KMS key usage logs for last 90d.

kevin: Mapping looks ~80% complete. The tricky bits are svc-acct impersonation chains in project-east that create indirect KMS usage. Will share CSV.

alice: For the reviews, suggest we: A) annotate owners with justification (<= 2 lines), B) create a temporary 'entitlement-review' policy that removes admin privileges, C) run canary revocations for low-risk roles.

maria: Agree. Also want to ensure we have audit+alert coverage during revocation windows. Audit-bot, can you confirm alerts on denied KMS:Decrypt events to pager?

audit-bot: Audit-bot: Alert rule 'kms-access-denied-high' active. Sends to #incidents on >5 denied per 10m.

lisa: Two operational notes: 1) KMS key rotations will force cache resets for some services; coordinate with teams. 2) If we automate grants via iam-reckoner, ensure we tag the PRs with 'entitlement-review' label.

kevin: Proposal for schedule: Week 1 - snapshot + owner justification; Week 2 - simulated least-priv test with dry-run IAM policy changes; Week 3 - canary revocations (5 teams); Week 4 - full rollout. Rollback plan: instant re-grant via 'entitlement-rollback' job (pre-approved for oncall).

josh: For simulations, use `policy-sim --account acme-prod --dry-run --days 90` — works well. Also run a quick fuzz test for service account impersonation.

maria: Good. Also need to add KMS key material rotation to checklist and confirm HSM/KMS admin roles limited to SRE/infra only.

alice: We should capture proof for compliance: CSV of pre/post access + signed justification doc. Ops can store in /compliance/access-reviews/2025-Q1.

maria: Who can own the runbook and the rollout? Volunteers?

kevin: I can own the mapping and simulation step.

lisa: I'll own coordination with apps and tagging PRs.

josh: I'll own the rollback job + canary monitoring dashboards.

maria: Thanks. I'll draft the runbook and timeline and post PR. Also adding a short eval to Redwood Optimize to verify perf regressions from any quantization changes that might be part of app-side mitigations.

audit-bot: Audit-bot: Created ticket SEC-ACQ-2025-14 with owner maria, due 2025-03-14.

maria: Sweet. If anyone thinks of additional risks (ephemeral creds, delegated admin roles, cross-project service tokens) drop them here. Otherwise I'll open the runbook PR tomorrow. :thumbsup: 

lisa: FYI — there are two orphaned key aliases in acme-legacy showing 0 usage; suggest we mark them for teardown in week 2.

kevin: noted. I'll include that in the CSV.

alice: small nit: ensure we rotate any KMS keys tied to long-lived CI tokens before revocation so builds don't fail unexpectedly.

maria: Good call — adding to checklist.

josh: ok moving to #incidents if we see >3 denied targets across more than one service during canary.

maria: Thanks team, will circulate PR link later.
